verdict.rationale: Pipecat documents its own in-pipeline capture features: AudioBufferProcessor records both user and bot audio, and turn events collect user and assistant messages for transcripts. The developer must store these artifacts and retrieve them per call themselves. The Pipecat Cloud REST API covers agents, secrets, builds and sessions, with no documented endpoint for retrieving recordings or transcripts. Missing for 10: a documented API or storage surface to retrieve recordings and transcripts for every call, automatic per-call persistence, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can retrieve full call recordings and transcripts programmatically for every call

citations.quote: Pipecat's \`AudioBufferProcessor\` makes it easy to capture high-quality audio recordings of both the user and bot during interactions.
Pipecat's turn events make it easy to collect both user and assistant messages as they occur.
